The response at a few distances from the center of the spectrum, for D_0 = 0.2 and W = 0.1. The ideal filter switches between 1 and 0 at once, at the band edges 0.15 and 0.25. In the zone plate of the figure, distance r from its center has frequency r / 160, so D = 0.1 lies 16 pixels from the center.
